summary: Completed testing of wallet/portfolio consistency issues. Identified ROOT CAUSE: _pick_wallet_connection scoring logic prioritizes readiness_score (online+can_trade) over wallet_score (balance>0), causing portfolio to show 0 balance when a connection is online but has no balance, even when other connections have balance.

critical.issue: spot_wallet_balance shows 0 when LIVE SPOT connection has 82.63 USDT balance. Root cause: _pick_wallet_connection in user_portfolio_engine.py prioritizes readiness_score over wallet_score. Connection 'user-live-spot' (online+can_trade, 0 balance) is selected over 'LIVE SPOT' (offline, 82.63 balance)
critical.fix_suggestion: Change scoring tuple order from (readiness_score, wallet_score, ...) to (wallet_score, readiness_score, ...) OR add combined score logic that considers both

minor.issue: No connections have readiness_snapshot.source='phase4_exchange_settings_sync' - Exchange Settings sync may not be preserving source field

integration_issues.issue: Login redirects to /admin/login?email=... instead of user dashboard. Known preview auth/session intermittency.
